script:
ip addr add 10.9.0.11/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-a
i=0; while [ $i -lt 20000 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; echo loop=$i; cat /proc/net/dev
echo hello-from-a | nc -w 2 10.9.0.13 7007; echo tcp=$?

ip addr add 10.9.0.12/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-b
ping -c 5 -i 0.2 10.9.0.11; echo ping=$?

ip addr add 10.9.0.13/24 dev eth0; ip link set eth0 up; echo up-c
echo reply-from-c | nc -l -p 7007 >/tmp/got; echo served=$?; cat /tmp/got
